confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live price checks. Restaurant and dorm anchors are moderate confidence; the 3-star hotel has the widest range, and July monsoon discounts are approximate. Draft beer is less common than bottled beer in Nepal, so the beer anchor reflects a comparable local lager serving. Cocktail and wine are set at about 2x the beer anchor because direct knowledge of local bar prices is weak. The FX value comes from search-result excerpts of rba.gov.au, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparator. The regional basis is Nepal's general price level and Kathmandu's tourist districts, loosely benchmarked against South Asian budget-tourism destinations. July is monsoon low season, so accommodation anchors reflect off-peak rather than trekking-season rates.
